rule: This file records representative Depth Study validation findings. It is not a lexical semantic owner and must not be used as runtime semantic fallback.

findings: Study previously failed to project verified secondary_senses; fine = 处以罚款 was valid Current content but invisible.
Study previously failed to project hydrated confusables because it read semantic_neighbors only.
deduct lacked an active learner construction for deduct A from B.
default lacked an active learner branch for by default despite the Core referencing preset/fallback meaning.
delicate compressed fragile and subtle/careful-handling meanings into reference-only material, making the learner-facing card underdeep.
assure -> ensure contrast existed only from one side; ensure now points to the same Relation owner with a reverse word view.
repairs: VocabularyWordRuntime projects verified independent secondary_senses and both semantic_neighbors/confusables.
deduct A from B added as a verified learner construction.
by default added as a verified learner construction.
delicate fragile and subtle/careful-handling branches restored as verified secondary_senses.
assure/ensure Relation owner made bidirectional and ensure relation_ref added.

findings: Many Current owners are already semantically deep; old display/projection was the larger problem. Do not manufacture semantic delta merely to make every audited word change.
Some secondary_senses duplicate an already-active source sense (for example engage/figure/issue). These must not create a fake +1 hidden branch.
Some deep construction records are presentation-merged into an already-active fixed-pattern collocation. Study must not display both copies.
subject to ... is high-value learner structure but currently appears only through usage-example collocations rather than an explicit learner construction.
come to terms with ... is high-value learner structure but currently appears only as a usage-example collocation under term.
maintain that ... is a high-value proposition pattern but currently appears only as a usage-example collocation.
runtime_repairs: Depth Study now excludes verified secondary_senses whose source_sense_id is already active in the same Word owner.
Depth Study now suppresses construction rows explicitly presentation-merged into a fixed-pattern collocation.
Stable target locators preserve original collocation/construction indexes after projection filtering.

semantic_repair_resolution.result: Added active be subject to sth learner construction on the existing adjective sense; no duplicate semantic branch.
Current term owner already contains L1 come to terms with sth construction.
Added active maintain that + clause proposition construction on the existing stance sense.

findings: bound is already a strong DIRECT_PASS owner: be bound to do, bound for, beyond the bounds of, and be bounded by are fixed learner patterns.

grant is already a strong DIRECT_PASS owner: grant that and take sth for granted are explicit learner constructions; its secondary-sense wrapper duplicates an active sense and is correctly suppressed from hidden +1 projection.
yield is already a strong DIRECT_PASS owner: produce, give way, noun yield, and yield to are all represented without needing semantic expansion.

claim is semantically mature, including active claim lives = cause death, so the secondary-sense wrapper must not create a fake hidden +1; claim that remains only a usage example and is a candidate for active proposition-pattern promotion.
bear is semantically rich and already owns bear in mind and bear on/upon, but its current mental_model_cn is only a compressed translation label and does not provide useful word-feel compression.
observe already exposes watch/notice/obey/celebrate/comment as active senses, including observe on + sth; its problem is not missing senses but weak word-feel compression.

draft is genuinely rich but also demonstrates a possible Recall Map overload risk: draft/sketch, bank draft, air current, draft beer, draft as write, and military draft all remain active. No deletion is justified without learner-use evidence, but this is a validation target for whether semantic richness exceeds scan value.

semantic_repair_resolution.result: Added active claim that + clause proposition construction on the existing assertion sense.
Current Word Feel already compresses endurance/support/production and keeps noun animal/finance branches separate.
Improved Word Feel to connect watch/notice, obey, commemorate and remark without adding duplicate senses.

batches.purpose: abstract academic meaning and proposition-pattern scan
findings: mean is a DIRECT_PASS academic-use owner: mean to do, mean that, be mean to, and the noun mean are already explicit; its deep secondary wrapper duplicates an active adjective sense and must remain suppressed from hidden +1.

note is a DIRECT_PASS owner for academic reading because note that ... is already a fixed learner pattern, while note down and noun note patterns remain available without requiring a new semantic object.
reason is a DIRECT_PASS owner: reason with sb and reason sb into/out of sth are already fixed patterns and the noun/verb split is explicit.
state is a DIRECT_PASS owner: state that + clause and state one's opinion are fixed patterns; the secondary-sense wrapper duplicates an active sense and is correctly suppressed.
stand is already deep enough for current Study: stand for sth, can't stand, and take a stand on sth are explicit. Its secondary-sense wrapper duplicates the active stance sense.

record already contains high-value familiar-new senses for past performance/history and for registering a reading/result/profit/loss, plus explicit good/poor record and criminal record constructions. This is a richness/scanability validation target rather than a missing-content case.

hold contains the high-value active sense 'hold an opinion/belief/view' but lacks an active proposition skeleton hold that + clause, so a familiar reader may know hold yet fail to retrieve the academic stance use quickly.
reach contains reach an agreement only as a usage example even though it is a high-value academic collocation; reach for/within reach/out of reach are already fixed.

semantic_repair_resolution.result: Added active hold that + clause formal stance construction on the existing opinion/belief sense.
Promoted existing reach an agreement collocation to fixed_pattern; no duplicate construction.
